interface.longDescription: Design, implement, inspect and test MCP servers and interactive MCP Apps using focused skills for tool contracts, host-aware interfaces, secure integration, debugging, visual quality and release preparation. Start with an idea, API specification or repository; work through actual coding tools available in the host. Choose real subagents when available; otherwise use a sequential workflow. Supports a useful tool-only fallback for clients without MCP Apps UI. Generated files, running tests, repository access and deployment depend on available host capabilities and user authorization; the plugin itself does not operate a hosted code-execution service.
defaultPrompt: Build an MCP App from this idea, including the server, a clean interactive UI, and tests.
Review this MCP server and fix its tools, security, and client compatibility issues.
Design an MCP App interface from my API specification and verify its tool-only fallback.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.4: Updated developer and author attribution to Tekris Labs, preserving existing skills, icons, starter prompts and product identity.
